name: Plot synaptic conductances and currents for PD and ND on both model beds
short_description: Run one PD trial + one ND trial on each model bed (Bed A: t0008/t0020 deposited Poleg-Polsky; Bed B: t0024 de Rosenroll), record g(t) and I(t) traces from every synapse instance, plot the population mean +/- SD per synapse type with PD and ND overlaid. Output: 2 multi-panel figures + a Typst-typeset PDF.
